units.source_text: 这人家的主人母尼僧，也是品质高尚的人。

en.t: The nun who was mistress of this household was also a woman of noble character.

units.source_text: 妹尼僧原是一位高贵官员的夫人，后来这官员死了。

en.t: The younger nun had originally been the wife of a high-ranking official, but later that official died.

units.source_text: 她只生一个女儿，非常疼爱，赘了一位贵公子为婿，悉心照料他们。

en.t: She had only one daughter, whom she loved dearly, and she took a noble young gentleman into the family as her son-in-law, caring for them both with great devotion.
But unexpectedly, this daughter too passed away.

units.source_text: 她悲伤之极，便削发被缁，做了尼僧，从此隐居在这山乡中。

en.t: Overcome with grief, she cut off her hair, put on black robes, became a nun, and from then on lived in seclusion in this mountain village.

units.source_text: 寂寞无聊之时，常常忧伤悲叹，总想找到一个相似之人，作为她所朝夕思慕的亡女的遗念。

en.t: Whenever loneliness and idleness overtook her, she would often grieve and lament, always wishing to find someone who resembled her lost daughter, as a living reminder of the child she longed for day and night.

units.source_text: 这回果然得到了这个意想不到的女子，而且相貌姿态比她的女儿优越得多。

en.t: This time she had indeed obtained this unexpected young woman, whose looks and bearing were far superior to those of her own daughter.

units.source_text: 她觉得很奇怪，仿佛是做梦，心中不胜欣喜。

en.t: She found it strange, as though she were dreaming, and her heart was filled with boundless joy.

units.source_text: 这妹尼僧年纪虽然大了，容姿却很清秀，举止态度也很文雅。

en.t: Although this younger nun was advanced in years, her appearance was still delicate and refined, and her manners and bearing were elegant.

units.source_text: 她们所住的小野地方，比浮舟从前所居的宇治山乡好很多，水声也很幽静。

en.t: The Ono area where they lived was much better than the mountain village of Uji where Ukifune had once stayed, and even the sound of the water was quiet and secluded.

units.source_text: 房屋建造式样别具风格，庭前树木姿态优美，花草也很可爱，是个极有趣致的住处。

en.t: The house was built in a distinctive style, the trees before the garden had graceful shapes, and the flowers and grasses were lovely, making it a residence of exceptional charm.
